name: LT1357 / LT1358 / LT1359
tagline: Low-power (2 mA/amp) sibling of the LT1364: 25 MHz, 600 V/µs. A niche sound-card buffer pick called warm and forward.

lineage.note: LT1354–LT1365 C-Load family on complementary bipolar process. LT1364 datasheet calls LT1358/9 its 'Lower Power Version'.
Hosts 135859fb and 1357fa and product pages; kept LTC file codes. No second sources.

part_numbers.note: Single, own datasheet 1357fa. N8 = DIP-8, S8 = SO-8, #PBF = lead-free.

part_numbers.pn: LT1358CN8#PBF / CS8 / CS8#PBF / CS8#TR / CS8#TRPBF / IN8#PBF / IS8#PBF / IS8#TRPBF
part_numbers.note: Audio favourite; DIP-8 fits sound-card sockets. CS8#PBF at Newark and DigiKey (2026).

part_numbers.pn: LT1359CN#PBF / CS#PBF / CS#TRPBF / CS14#PBF / CS14#TRPBF / IN#PBF / IS#PBF / IS#TRPBF / IS14#PBF / IS14#TRPBF
part_numbers.note: Quad. Difference between 'S' and 'S14' SO packages unverified.

key_specs.value: 2.5 mA max per amp (about 2 mA typ)
key_specs.condition: max at ±5 V; typ from LT1364 table

key_specs.value: ±12.5 V min swing into 500 Ω (current not stated)
Bipolar single-stage VFB, CFB-like slewing, C-Load stable

reputation.summary: A niche pick from the sound-card op-amp-rolling era (Asus Xonar, Audiotrak Prodigy HD2). Forum posts call the LT1358 "warm, bright, tonal rich and sounds forward"; some prefer it to the faster LT1364 in buffer duty, and it is named alongside the LT1364 and LT1361. Subjective impressions only; no ASR or Samuel Groner measurements exist.
typical_uses: DIY DAC buffer and I/V stages
Wideband amps, active filters, video/cable drivers
caveats: Praise rests on a few subjective forum posts.
25 MHz / 600 V/µs: keep layout tight and decouple locally; C-Load won't fix long socket leads.
Low power (2.5 mA max/amp); output current unverified, so check before driving headphones.
Bipolar inputs with up to 500 nA bias: watch offset with high source impedances.
Supply limit is ±15 V; ±18 V rails are out of spec.

counterfeit_notes: No specific reports. Buy from authorized ADI distributors; distrust marketplace DIP-8s, especially leaded non-#PBF parts sold new. Remarked slow parts miss 600 V/µs or 25 MHz; supply should be ≤ 2.5 mA/amp. Compare marking and date code.
